Generated from the pinned source snapshot by scripts/build-vis.mjs. Upstream JSON is inlined and resolveSeriesColors gains an optional host palette bridge with ordered palette reuse for overflow data items. Data waterfall bars fit the available band. Combination charts take line colors from the host line palette. The world heatmap keeps the pinned upstream CDN map and flags, so that chart alone needs network. D3 7.9.0 and esbuild 0.25.9 are pinned build dependencies; apart from the world heatmap the runtime bundle needs no network.
